objective: Reduce battery-energy use in a fictional edge-service workload
hypothesis: Batch nonurgent telemetry writes into 30-second windows to reduce radio wakeups

supporting_evidence.observation: Frequent single-record writes trigger many radio wakeups

critique: Batching may increase event latency and lose unsent records on power loss; compare against an immediate-write baseline

ranking_rubric.testability: high: compare two write schedules on the same simulated trace

human_decision: Approve a controlled experiment only; do not claim energy savings yet
